name: Entre Chien et Loup
source:
"To Nyarindë, the Wandering Witch,"

"You once said that name means ‘the storyteller’ — one born to preserve every tale across the land of Myaloú.
But you never realized that you yourself were the tale left untold."

"If Nyarindë is the storyteller, then who will tell her story?"

"And so, I wrote this book... to keep the memory of a time I will never forget."

— Baldur, Entre Chien et Loup
